from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
head = subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
if head != "d6114a1564542b17309f91423d533345c8056307":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected head {head}")

p = wt / "src/do_again/core/agent.py"
lines = p.read_text().splitlines()

needles = [
    "publish_receipt",
    "receipt_callback",
    "ledger_path",
    "blocked_ambiguous_replay",
    "state =",
    "receipt_payload",
]
hits = [i for i,l in enumerate(lines,1) if any(n in l for n in needles)]
seen = set()
for hit in hits:
    start=max(1,hit-8); end=min(len(lines),hit+24)
    if (start,end) in seen: continue
    seen.add((start,end))
    print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
    for n in range(start,end+1):
        print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")
